t: Nothing is early and nothing is late
a: قُل لَّآ أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِى ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ ۚ إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
p: …li-kulli ummatin ajal, idhā jā'a ajaluhum fa-lā yasta'khirūna sāʿatan wa lā yastaqdimūn.
m: Say, "I possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what Allāh should will. For every nation is a [specified] term. When their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
